chunk_map.heading: About the future, all was blurry

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8 'It gave me anxiety' is the nearest pronoun; its antecedent is the not-knowing stated in L4-L6 ('could not tell which of our bets...', 'all was blurry') inside the same chunk, and the cause is the situation the slide narrates. L4 'Then came' is a temporal join, not a demonstrative aimed at an unnamed object.

grep -nE 'opening|earlier lecture|the (first|previous) (slide|lecture)' body -> 0; closest is L4 'Then came a year inside an AI transformation', a narrative join that names its own content and points at no file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -nE 'the .* you (did|saw|caught)' body -> 0; closest L4 'a year inside an AI transformation' names the narrator's own year, not a module beat.
L4-L8: three short paragraphs carry one claim (I could not tell which bets were right and it cost me); the slide stands alone.
H2 'About the future, all was blurry' (L1) vs L6 'About the future, all was blurry.' and L4 'could not tell which of our bets would turn out right': the content confirms the header literally.

Closest: L6 'I don't understand often what is happening. I don't see.' is an anaphora pair, not a triple; no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.', no superlative, no number+retraction, no abstraction stack, no verb triplet. Third leg L8 is a different construction.
